name: Generate specific sections for academic papers and theses
description: Users requested the generation of specific sections, chapters, or complete texts for academic papers, theses, and professional articles, often specifying word counts, citation styles, and content requirements. Requests varied in scope, including literature reviews, introductions, essay chapters, and technical reports, with some asking for the text to be saved in specific file formats.
